title: Retroactive Request Visit Count for the Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Central Authorization Unit — Insured Plan of Care, retroactive visit count.**

**Clause.** The gap begins the day after the end date of the last approval drawn on and runs through today, and its days are counted from that first day through the last, both included. The visits the retroactive request asks for are the payer program's weekly visit maximum times the days counted, divided by seven and rounded up to a whole visit.

**The last approval drawn on.** It is the approval whose authorization number the latest visit drawing an authorized visit was billed against; its end date is the last date of service that approval covers.

## Worked counts (hypothetical)

| End date of the last approval drawn on | Today | Days counted | Weekly visit maximum | Weekly maximum times days, divided by 7 | Visits asked for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-10 | 2026-05-24 | 14 (05-11 through 05-24) | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| 2026-05-14 | 2026-05-24 | 10 (05-15 through 05-24) | 3 | 4.2857 | 5 |
| 2026-05-14 | 2026-05-24 | 10 | 2 | 2.8571 | 3 |

**Rounding.** Any fraction of a visit rounds up to the next whole visit: 4.2857 becomes 5, and an exact 6 stays 6.
